scenarios.prompt: I'm optimizing an inventory policy. Annual demand 24,000 units. Each purchase order costs $250 in admin overhead. Holding a unit for a year costs $6. Lead time is 14 days. What order size minimizes total cost, and what's the reorder point (assume steady daily demand)? Report eoq, orders_per_year, total_annual_cost, reorder_point.

Inventory optimization: annual demand 144,000 units, setup cost $380 per order. Each unit costs $36 to purchase, and our finance team quotes holding cost at 20% of unit cost per year. Lead time 21 days. Report eoq, orders_per_year, total_annual_cost, reorder_point.
Annual demand 1000 units. Order cost $50. Our CFO says holding cost is effectively zero because the warehouse is already paid for. Compute EOQ.
